title: BECE Mathematics Geometry & Measurement - Mathematics - Plane Shapes (2D)
subject: Mathematics

questions.q: Which of the following properties is true for all squares but not necessarily for all rhombuses?
options: All sides are equal in length.
Diagonals bisect each other at 90 degrees.
questions.explain: Both squares and rhombuses have equal sides and diagonals that bisect at right angles. However, a square must have all interior angles equal to $90^\circ$, whereas a rhombus does not necessarily have $90^\circ$ angles.
questions.subject: Mathematics

questions.q: Calculate the perimeter of a regular hexagon with a side length of $8 \text{ cm}$.
questions.explain: A regular hexagon has 6 equal sides. Perimeter $= 6 \times \text{side length} = 6 \times 8 = 48 \text{ cm}$.
questions.subject: Mathematics

questions.q: What is the area of a triangle with a base of $10 \text{ cm}$ and a height of $6 \text{ cm}$?
questions.explain: Area of a triangle $= \frac{1}{2} \times \text{base} \times \text{height} = \frac{1}{2} \times 10 \times 6 = 30 \text{ cm}^2$.
questions.subject: Mathematics

questions.q: The area of a circle is calculated using the formula $A = \pi r^2$. Calculate the area of a circle with radius $7 \text{ cm}$. (Take $\pi = \frac{22}{7}$)
questions.explain: Area $= \frac{22}{7} \times 7^2 = \frac{22}{7} \times 49 = 22 \times 7 = 154 \text{ cm}^2$.
questions.subject: Mathematics

questions.q: Which quadrilateral has only one pair of parallel sides?
questions.explain: A trapezium (or trapezoid) is defined as having exactly one pair of parallel sides. Parallelograms, rectangles, and rhombuses have two pairs.
questions.subject: Mathematics

questions.q: Calculate the area of a parallelogram with a base of $12 \text{ m}$ and a perpendicular height of $5 \text{ m}$.
questions.explain: Area of a parallelogram $= \text{base} \times \text{height} = 12 \times 5 = 60 \text{ m}^2$.
questions.subject: Mathematics

questions.q: The sum of the interior angles of a quadrilateral is:
questions.explain: The sum of interior angles of a polygon is $(n-2) \times 180$. For a quadrilateral ($n=4$), sum $= (4-2) \times 180 = 360^\circ$.
questions.subject: Mathematics

questions.q: Find the area of a trapezium where the parallel sides are $8 \text{ cm}$ and $12 \text{ cm}$, and the height is $5 \text{ cm}$.
questions.explain: Area $= \frac{1}{2}(a+b)h = \frac{1}{2}(8+12) \times 5 = \frac{1}{2}(20) \times 5 = 10 \times 5 = 50 \text{ cm}^2$.
questions.subject: Mathematics

questions.q: If the diameter of a circle is $14 \text{ cm}$, what is its circumference? (Take $\pi = \frac{22}{7}$)
questions.explain: Circumference $C = \pi d = \frac{22}{7} \times 14 = 22 \times 2 = 44 \text{ cm}$.
questions.subject: Mathematics

questions.q: A triangle with all three sides equal is called:
questions.explain: An equilateral triangle has all three sides equal and all three angles equal to $60^\circ$.
questions.subject: Mathematics

questions.q: Calculate the perimeter of a rectangle with length $15 \text{ cm}$ and width $4 \text{ cm}$.
questions.subject: Mathematics

questions.q: A parallelogram has an area of $96 \text{ cm}^2$ and a base of $12 \text{ cm}$. Find its height.
questions.explain: Area $= \text{base} \times \text{height} \Rightarrow 96 = 12 \times h \Rightarrow h = 96 / 12 = 8 \text{ cm}$.
questions.subject: Mathematics

questions.q: The length of the boundary around a circle is known as the:
questions.explain: The perimeter of a circle is specifically called the circumference.
questions.subject: Mathematics

questions.q: If the side of a square is doubled, the area increases by a factor of:
questions.explain: Let side $= s$. Area $= s^2$. If new side $= 2s$, new Area $= (2s)^2 = 4s^2$. The area increases by a factor of 4.
questions.subject: Mathematics

questions.q: Which of the following is NOT a property of a rectangle?
questions.explain: For a standard rectangle, diagonals bisect each other but not necessarily at $90^\circ$ (unless it is a square).
questions.subject: Mathematics

questions.q: Find the length of a side of a square whose area is $81 \text{ cm}^2$.
questions.explain: Area $= s^2 = 81$. Side $s = \sqrt{81} = 9 \text{ cm}$.
questions.subject: Mathematics

questions.q: A Kite has diagonals of length $10 \text{ cm}$ and $24 \text{ cm}$. What is its area?
questions.explain: Area of a kite $= \frac{p \times q}{2}$ where $p​$ and $q​$ are diagonals. Area $= \frac{10 \times 24}{2} = 120 \text{ cm}^2$.
questions.subject: Mathematics

questions.q: How many lines of symmetry does an equilateral triangle have?
questions.explain: An equilateral triangle has 3 lines of symmetry, each passing from a vertex to the midpoint of the opposite side.
questions.subject: Mathematics

questions.q: Calculate the area of a sector of a circle with radius $7 \text{ cm}$ and angle $90^\circ$. (Take $\pi = \frac{22}{7}$)
questions.explain: Area $= \frac{\theta}{360} \times \pi r^2 = \frac{90}{360} \times \frac{22}{7} \times 7^2 = \frac{1}{4} \times 154 = 38.5 \text{ cm}^2$.
questions.subject: Mathematics

questions.q: What is the name of a polygon with 8 sides?
questions.explain: An 8-sided polygon is called an Octagon.
questions.subject: Mathematics
